prompt: Match each rladmin command to its effect on a Redis Software cluster.
explanation: `status shards` is the read-only view of where every shard lives and what role it plays. `migrate shard ... target_node` relocates one shard, `bind ... policy all-nodes` re-binds the database's endpoint to a proxy on every node, `node 3 remove` retires a node once the cluster has migrated its resources, and `tune db ... repl_backlog` controls the Replica Of replication backlog size.

pairs.right: Show each shard's node, role, and status
Relocate one shard to another node

pairs.left: rladmin bind db db:1 endpoint 1:1 policy all-nodes
pairs.right: Re-bind the endpoint to proxies on all nodes
Remove a node after its resources migrate away

pairs.left: rladmin tune db db:1 repl_backlog auto
pairs.right: Size the Replica Of replication backlog
